articles.title: H.I.G. Growth Partners Completes Sale of ProsperOps
articles.mainIdea: H.I.G. Growth Partners Completes Sale of ProsperOps
articles.summary: CNW Group: H.I.G. Growth Partners Completes Sale of ProsperOps. H.I.G. Growth Partners ("H.I.G. Growth"), the dedicated growth capital investment affiliate of H.I.G. Capital, a leading global alternative investment firm with $74 billion of capital under management, is pleased to announce the sale of its portfolio company ProsperOps, Inc. ("ProsperOps" or the "Company"), a provider of autonomous cloud cost optimization software, to Flexera, a portfolio company of Thoma Bravo. Related tickers mentioned: MSFT.

articles.title: The Hartford Expands Technology Team With New Office In Columbus, Ohio
articles.mainIdea: The Hartford Expands Technology Team With New Office In Columbus, Ohio
articles.summary: Business Wire: The Hartford Expands Technology Team With New Office In Columbus, Ohio. COLUMBUS, Ohio, January 06, 2026--The Hartford today announced the opening of its newest technology hub in Columbus, Ohio. This strategic expansion is the latest example of the company’s commitment to insurance innovation, collaboration, and delivering exceptional experiences for customers, agents and brokers.
